topic: plague at Rome and fetching of the Epidaurian serpent of Aesculapius
quote_la: horrendumque illum Epidaurium colubrum cum ipso Aesculapi lapide aduexerint

topic: Fabius Gurges defeated by the Samnites, saved by his father's intervention
quote_la: Fabius Gurges consul male aduersum Samnitas pugnauit. namque amisso exercitu uictus in urbem refugit

topic: Samnite leader Pontius defeated and captured
quote_la: donec ipsum Pontium ducem deleto hostili exercitu uictum oppressumque ceperunt

topic: Senones kill Roman envoys; praetor Caecilius sent against them
quote_la: quos cum Galli interfecissent, Caecilius praetor ob ulciscendam legatorum necem et conprimendum tumultum hostium cum exercitu missus

topic: Tarentines attack the passing Roman fleet, provoking war
quote_la: Tarentini Romanam classem forte praetereuntem, spectaculo theatri prospectam hostiliter inuaserunt

topic: Pyrrhus takes over the Tarentine war against Rome
quote_la: Tarentinos, plurimis finitimorum praesidiis fultos, maxime Pyrrhus auxit

topic: first battle of Pyrrhus and consul Laevinus at Heraclea on the Liris
quote_la: apud Heracleam, Campaniae urbem, fluuiumque Lirim prima inter Pyrrhum regem et Laeuinum consulem pugna commissa est

topic: Romans terrified by the unfamiliar elephants
quote_la: introductos autem inter concurrentia agmina elephantos forma truces, odore graues, mole terribiles ut uidere Romani

topic: second battle: Pyrrhus wounded, the legate Fabricius wounded
quote_la: Pyrrhus, transfixo bracchio saucius, prior cessit e proelio. sed et Fabricius legatus tunc uulneratus est

topic: Pyrrhus back from Sicily met by Curius in the third battle on the Arusine plains
quote_la: reuersum ex Sicilia Pyrrhum Curius consul excepit, tertiumque id bellum contra Epirotas apud Lucaniam in Arusinis campis gestum est

topic: Pyrrhus throws in his elephants, which the Romans turn with fire
quote_la: Pyrrhus elephantos ex subsidiis iussit induci

topic: after Pyrrhus' death the Tarentines renew war with Carthaginian help and are defeated
quote_la: Tarentini Pyrrhi morte conperta iterum noua aduersum Romanos arma sollicitant, Carthaginiensium auxilia per legatos poscunt atque accipiunt

topic: the eighth legion massacres the people of Regium it was garrisoning
quote_la: octaua legio diffidens Romanae spei, nouum scelus ausa Reginenses omnes, quibus subsidio praeerat, interfecit

topic: the rebel legion scourged and beheaded in the forum at Rome
quote_la: qui populi iussu medio in foro uirgis caesi sunt securique percussi

topic: Appius Claudius sent to Messana against Hiero and the Carthaginians
quote_la: auxilia contra Hieronem Syracusanum regem et Poenorum copias Hieroni iunctas et Appium Claudium consulem cum exercitu misere Romani

topic: Hiero, terrified, sues for peace
quote_la: ipse quoque rex rerum magnitudine perterritus ante se uictum quam congressum fuisse prodiderit

topic: consul Cornelius Asina lured to a sham parley and treacherously captured
quote_la: ab Hannibale quasi ad conloquium pacis euocatus Punica fraude captus atque in uinculis necatus est

topic: Duilius defeats Hannibal in the naval battle
quote_la: commisso nauali proelio Hannibal, amissa naui qua uehebatur, scapha subductus aufugit

topic: Regulus fights the monstrous serpent at the river Bagradas
quote_la: serpens mirae magnitudinis deuoraret, Regulus ad expugnandam bestiam cum exercitu profectus est

topic: Xanthippus crushes the Roman army; Regulus taken prisoner
quote_la: Regulus ille dux nobilis cum quingentis uiris captus est et in catenas coniectus

topic: Regulus, back from his embassy, tortured to death with eyelids cut away
quote_la: quem non impetrata pace ab Italia reuersum resectis palpebris inligatum in machina uigilando necauerunt

topic: Metellus defeats Hasdrubal's elephants at Panormus and leads them through Italy
quote_la: elephanti quoque sex et uiginti interfecti centum et quattuor capti et per Italiam ducti

topic: Claudius defeated by the Punic fleet off Drepana
quote_la: Claudius consul cum classe centum uiginti nauium ad Drepani portum contra hostem profectus: ubi mox exceptus classe Poenorum superatusque est

topic: the rebellious Falisci defeated with 15,000 killed
quote_la: cum Faliscis bellauere Romani, eoque proelio quindecim milia Faliscorum interfecta sunt

topic: Sardinia revolts at Carthaginian instigation and is subdued
quote_la: Sardinia insula rebellauit auctoribus Poenis. unde mox Sardi subacti et oppressi sunt

topic: Claudius Marcellus kills the Gallic king Virdomarus and takes Mediolanum
quote_la: ipse Virdomarum regem in primam aciem progressus occidit

topic: outbreak of the Third Punic War; senate votes to destroy Carthage
quote_la: tertium Punicum bellum exortum est. igitur cum senatus delendam Carthaginem censuisset

topic: Carthaginians surrender arms and are ordered to move ten miles from the sea
quote_la: relicta urbe recedere procul a mari decem milibus passuum iussi sunt

topic: young Scipio shields the repulsed consuls before Carthage
quote_la: quos fugientes Scipio repulso intra muros hoste defendit

topic: Masinissa dies; Scipio divides Numidia among his three sons
quote_la: Scipio Masinissa mortuo inter Masinissae filios tres Numidiae regnum diuisit

topic: praetor Iuventius destroyed in Macedonia by Pseudophilippus
quote_la: Iuuentius praetor in Macedonia aduersus Pseudophilippum congressus cum maxima clade totius Romani exercitus interfectus est

topic: Hasdrubal surrenders; his wife hurls herself and her sons into the flames
quote_la: uxor Hasdrubalis se duosque filios secum uirili dolore et furore femineo in medium iecit incendium

topic: Carthage burns for seventeen days
quote_la: ipsa autem ciuitas decem et septem continuis diebus arsit

topic: Metellus defeats the Achaeans and Boeotians, first at Thermopylae
quote_la: nam cum Metellus praetor Achaeos Boeotiosque coniunctos duobus bellis, hoc est primum apud Thermopylas

topic: Mummius storms and destroys wealthy Corinth
quote_la: qui dimisso statim Metello Corinthum sine mora expugnauit, urbem toto tunc orbe longe omnium opulentissimam

topic: rise of the Lusitanian shepherd-brigand Viriathus
quote_la: Viriatus in Hispania genere Lusitanus, homo pastoralis et latro

topic: Appius Claudius fights the Salassi, first beaten then victorious
quote_la: Appius Claudius aduersus Salassos Gallos congressus et uictus quinque milia militum perdidit

topic: consul Q. Pompeius routed in Numantine territory
quote_la: Pompeius sequentis anni consul fines Numantinorum ingressus accepta maxima clade discessit

topic: Viriathus murdered by his own men; his killers denied their reward
quote_la: insidiis suorum interfectus est, in hoc solo Romanis circa eum fortiter agentibus, quod percussores eius indignos praemio iudicarunt

topic: Mancinus, defeated repeatedly, forced into a shameful treaty with Numantia
quote_la: adeo infeliciter proelia cuncta gessit atque in id suprema desperatione perductus est, ut turpissimum foedus cum Numantinis facere cogeretur

topic: Mancinus handed over naked to the Numantines, who refuse to take him
quote_la: Mancinum dedi Numantinis praecepit, qui nudato corpore manibusque post tergum reuinctis ante portas Numantinorum expositus

topic: Brutus overwhelms 60,000 Callaeci in Further Spain
quote_la: Brutus in ulteriore Hispania LX milia Gallaecorum, qui Lusitanis auxilio uenerant, asperrimo bello et difficili quamuis incautos circumuenisset, oppressit

topic: Lepidus attacks the Vaccaei against the senate's will and suffers disaster
quote_la: Lepidus proconsule Vaccaeos, innoxiam gentem et supplicem, etiam senatu prohibente pertinaciter expugnare temptauit

topic: Scipio elected consul by consent of all the tribes and sent against Numantia
quote_la: Scipio Africanus consensu omnium tribuum consul creatus atque ad expugnandam Numantiam cum exercitu missus est

topic: Scipio drills the corrupted army in camp before engaging
quote_la: aliquamdiu militem suum in castris uelut in scholis exercuit

topic: Tiberius Gracchus, angry at the nobility, pushes division of public land
quote_la: Gracchus tribunus plebi iratus nobilitati, cur inter auctores Numantini foederis notatus esset, agrum a priuatis eatenus possessum populo diuidi statuit

topic: Attalus' bequest of Asia to the Roman people; Gracchus' money law
quote_la: Attalus, Eumenis filius, moriens testamento populum Romanum imperio Asiae succedere heredem iusserat

topic: Gracchus struck down with a bench fragment and a club
quote_la: ictus fragmento subsellii conruit rursusque adsurgens alio ictu clauae cerebro inpactae exanimatus est

topic: the starving Numantines offer surrender and destroy themselves
quote_la: igitur conclusi diu Numantini et fame trucidati deditionem sui obtulerunt

topic: death of Crassus and defeat of his army in the war with Aristonicus
quote_la: audita morte Crassi et clade exercitus Romani raptim in Asiam peruolauit

topic: Aristonicus strangled in prison at Rome by order of the senate
quote_la: Aristonicus Romae iussu senatus in carcere strangulatus est

topic: locust plague and pestilence devastate Africa and Numidia under Micipsa
quote_la: in Numidia, in qua tunc Micipsa rex erat, octingenta milia hominum

topic: Metellus subdues the Balearic islands and suppresses their piracy
quote_la: Metellus Baleares insulas bello peruagatus edomuit

topic: C. Gracchus and Flaccus killed; 250 of the faction slain on the Aventine
quote_la: ex factione Gracchi ducenti quinquaginta in Auentino caesi fuisse referuntur

topic: Domitius defeats the Allobroges at the town of Vindalium
quote_la: Gnaeus quoque Domitius proconsule Allobrogas Gallos iuxta oppidum Vindalium grauissimo bello uicit

topic: Fabius confronts Bituitus, king of the Arverni, with a small army
quote_la: Fabius consul Bituito regi Aruernorum Galliae ciuitatis bellum maximo instructu conparanti adeo cum paruo exercitu occurrit

topic: Jugurtha, Micipsa's adopted heir, kills Hiempsal and expels Adherbal
quote_la: Iugurtha, Micipsae Numidarum regis adoptiuus heresque inter naturales eius filios factus, primum coheredes suos, id est Hiempsalem occidit, Adherbalem bello uictum Africa expulit

topic: the Vestal Aemilia and two other Vestals convicted of unchastity
quote_la: Aemiliam uirginem Vestalem furtiuo stupro polluit. duas praeterea uirgines Vestales eadem Aemilia ad participationem incesti sollicitatas

topic: consul Calpurnius bribed by Jugurtha into a disgraceful peace
quote_la: Calpurnium deinde consulem aduersum se missum pecunia corrupit atque ad turpissimas condiciones pacis adduxit

topic: Jugurtha's gibe at venal Rome on leaving the city
quote_la: O urbem uenalem et mature perituram, si emptorem inuenerit

topic: Aulus Postumius defeated at Calama and forced to an ignominious treaty
quote_la: apud Calamam urbem thesauris regiis conditis inhiantem bello oppressit adque uicto ignominiosissimum foedus exegit

topic: Metellus' discipline defeats Jugurtha in two battles
quote_la: Metelli consulis integritate et disciplina coercitus, duobus etiam proeliis uictus

topic: consul Cassius ambushed and killed by the Tigurini
quote_la: L. Cassius consul in Gallia Tigurinos usque Oceanum persecutus rursusque ab isdem insidiis circumuentus occisus est

topic: the survivors buy safety with hostages and half their goods
quote_la: obsides et dimidiam partem rerum omnium Tigurinis turpissimo foedere dedit

topic: Jugurtha allies himself with Bocchus of Mauretania
quote_la: diffidens deinde propriis rebus et uiribus Iugurtha societatem cum Boccho Maurorum rege fecit

topic: Bocchus buys peace by delivering Jugurtha in chains through Sulla to Marius
quote_la: in pretium pacis Iugurtham dolo captum catenisque obrutum per Syllam legatum misit ad Marium

topic: Jugurtha led before Marius' chariot with his two sons and strangled in prison
quote_la: qui in triumpho ante currum cum duobus filiis suis actus et mox in carcere strangulatus est

topic: disaster of Arausio: 80,000 soldiers and 40,000 camp-followers killed (citing Antias)
quote_la: LXXX milia Romanorum sociorumque ea tempestate trucidata, XL milia calonum atque lixarum interfecta Antias scribit

topic: Marius destroys the Teutones: 200,000 killed, king Teutobodus slain
quote_la: ducenta milia armatorum in eo bello interfecta sunt, octoginta milia capta, uix tria milia fugisse referuntur; dux quoque eorum Teutobodus occisus est

topic: Marius, consul for the fifth time, sent with Catulus against the Cimbri in Italy
quote_la: Marius V consul et Catulus aduersum eos missi

topic: the Cimbri annihilated: 140,000 killed, 60,000 captured
quote_la: centum quadraginta milia eorum tunc in bello caesa, sexaginta milia capta dicuntur

topic: Saturninus and Glaucia murder his rival candidate Nunius
quote_la: A. Nunium deinde, conpetitorem suum, Saturninus et Glaucia fraude C. Marii consulis occiderunt

topic: Metellus Numidicus unjustly condemned goes into exile
quote_la: per scelus innocens Metellus damnatus in exilium cum totius urbis dolore discessit

topic: Saturninus and his partisans killed in the curia by the equites
quote_la: per equites Romanos effractis foribus occisi sunt

topic: tribune Livius Drusus rouses the Latins with the hope of freedom
quote_la: Liuius Drusus, tribunus plebi, Latinos omnes spe libertatis inlectos cum placito explere non posset, in arma excitauit

topic: Drusus assassinated at home by an unknown hand
quote_la: Drusus tantis malis anxius domi suae incerto quidem auctore interfectus est

topic: the Italian peoples (Picentes, Vestini, Marsi, Paeligni, Marrucini, Samnites, Lucani) plot revolt
quote_la: Picentes Vestini Marsi Paeligni Marrucini Samnites Lucani cum adhuc occultam defectionem meditarentur

topic: praetor Servius and Roman citizens massacred at Asculum
quote_la: C. Seruium praetorem, legatum ad se missum, apud Asculum occiderunt

topic: consul Julius Caesar defeated by the Samnites with loss of his army
quote_la: Iulius Caesar Samnitium pugna uictus caeso fugit exercitu

topic: consul Rutilius ambushed by the Marsi and killed with 8,000 men
quote_la: ubi et ipse consul occisus et multi nobiles interfecti et octo milia Romanorum militum caesa sunt

topic: after Caesar's victory the senate lays aside the garb of mourning
quote_la: senatus saga, hoc est uestem maeroris, quam exorto sociali bello sumpserat, hac spe adridente deposuit

topic: Pompeius routs the Picentes; the senate resumes the insignia of office
quote_la: Cn. Pompeius Picentes graui proelio fudit, qua uictoria senatus laticlauia et cetera dignitatis insignia recepit

topic: Postumius Albinus stoned to death by his own soldiers
quote_la: intolerabili superbia omnium in se militum odia suscitasset, lapidibus occisus est

topic: Sulla kills 18,000 Samnites in battle
quote_la: decem et octo milia Samnitium illo proelio caesa sunt

topic: consul Porcius Cato killed fighting the Marsi at the Fucine lake
quote_la: cum ad lacum Fucinum contra Marsos bellum gereret, a filio C. Marii in tumultu belli quasi ab incerto auctore prostratus est

topic: legate Gabinius killed while storming the enemy camp
quote_la: C. Gabinius legatus in expugnatione hostilium castrorum interfectus est

topic: Popaedius and Obsidius crushed and killed at the river Teanum
quote_la: Popaedius et Obsidius, Italici imperatores, ab eodem Sulpicio apud flumen Teanum horribili proelio oppressi et occisi sunt

topic: Pompeius enters Asculum and executes its leaders
quote_la: Pompeius Asculum ingressus praefectos centuriones cunctosque principes eorum uirgis cecidit securique percussit

topic: Sulla storms into Rome with his army against Marius and Sulpicius
quote_la: mox urbem cum exercitu inrupit, faces ad inflammandam urbem poposcit

topic: Sulpicius' betraying slave freed and then hurled from the Tarpeian rock
quote_la: seruum uero ipsum, quod hostem indicauerat, manumitti, quod uero dominum prodiderat, saxo Tarpeio deici consules decreuerunt

topic: Marius hides in the marshes of Minturnae and is dragged out
quote_la: in Minturnensium paludibus sese abdidit; e quibus infeliciter luto oblitus ignominioseque protractus

topic: Mithridates orders all Roman citizens in Asia killed on a single day
quote_la: crudeli praecepit edicto, ut per totam Asiam quicumque inuenti essent ciues Romani sub una die omnes necarentur

topic: Archelaus sent ahead to Greece seizes Athens
quote_la: Athenas cunctamque Graeciam partim ui partim deditione obtinuit

topic: Marius returns from Africa and joins consul Cinna
quote_la: continuo Romam regressus Cinnae consuli societate scelerum coniunctus est

topic: the rebel forces divided in four under Marius, Carbo, Sertorius and Cinna
quote_la: tres siquidem legiones Mario datae, parti copiarum Cn. Carbo praepositus est, partem Sertorius accepit

topic: a soldier recognizes the brother he killed and slays himself
quote_la: miles Pompeianus fratris sui, quem ipse interfecerat, corpus adgnouit

topic: Marius storms Antium and Aricia
quote_la: Marius Antium et Ariciam ciuitates hostiliter inrupit cunctosque in his praeter proditores interfecit

topic: Cinna and Marius enter Rome and butcher senators and consulars
quote_la: post Cinna consul cum legionibus et Marius cum fugitiuis urbem ingressi nobilissimos quosque e senatu et plurimos consulares uiros interfecerunt

topic: Marius dies at the beginning of his seventh consulship
quote_la: septimum consulatum cum Cinna tertium consule peruasisset, in exordio consularis imperii sera tandem morte praereptus est

topic: Sulla besieges the Piraeus and takes Athens by storm
quote_la: Archelaum apud Piraeum, Atheniensium portum septemplici muro conmunitum, diu obsedit, ipsam Atheniensium urbem ui cepit

topic: Sulla destroys Archelaus' army of 110,000
quote_la: centum decem milia de exercitu Archelai interfecta, uix decem milia superfuisse referuntur

topic: second royal army defeated with 50,000 killed
quote_la: secundo proelio quinquaginta milia ex his interfecta sunt ibique Diogenes Archelai filius trucidatus est

topic: consul Flaccus murdered at Nicomedia by his legate Fimbria
quote_la: Flaccum consulem, cui legatus ierat, apud Nicomediam occidit

topic: Fimbria destroys Ilium by fire and sword
quote_la: ipsam urbem Ilium, antiquam illam Romae parentem, funditus caede incendioque deleuit

topic: Fimbria, besieged and deserted, kills himself in the temple of Aesculapius
quote_la: apud Thyatiram cum ab exercitu Syllae obsideretur, desperatione adactus in templo Aesculapii manu sua interfectus est

topic: Cinna killed by his own army in his fourth consulship
quote_la: idemque Cinna quarto consul ab exercitu suo interfectus est

topic: Sulla lands in Campania and crushes consul Norbanus
quote_la: Sylla mox ut Campanum litus attigit, Norbanum consulem proelio oppressit

topic: Fabius Hadrianus burned alive with his household at Utica
quote_la: apud Uticam congestis sarmentis cum omni familia uiuus incensus est

topic: Damasippus slaughters Scaevola and other nobles summoned to the curia
quote_la: Damasippus praetor incentore Mario consule Q. Scaeuolam C. Carbonem L. Domitium P. Antistium in curiam quasi ad consultandum uocatos crudelissime occidit

topic: Sulla crushes the younger Marius at Sacriportus with 25,000 killed
quote_la: Syllae etiam et Marii adulescentis maximum tunc proelium apud Sacriportum fuit, in quo de exercitu Marii caesa sunt XXV milia

topic: Sulla's victory in the battle at the Colline Gate
quote_la: ante ipsam urbem portamque Collinam ad horam diei nonam signa contulit grauissimoque proelio tandem uicit

topic: Sulla posts the first proscription list of eighty names
quote_la: primus infamem illam tabulam proscriptionis induxit. prima proscriptio octoginta hominum fuit

topic: young Marius at Praeneste dies in a mutual death-pact with Telesinus
quote_la: ne in manus incideret inimicorum, cum Telesino mutua morte concurrit

topic: Pompey drags Carbo back to Sicily and executes him
quote_la: Pompeius Carbonem a Cossura insula in Aegyptum fugere conantem, in Siciliam ad se retractum conpluresque cum eo socios eius occidit

topic: Sulla created dictator
quote_la: Sylla dictator creatus est, ut dominationis et crudelitatis libido honesti praecipuique nominis reuerentia et armaretur et uelaretur

topic: after Sulla's death Lepidus rises against Catulus and rekindles civil war
quote_la: Sylla mortuo Lepidus, Marianae partis adsertor, aduersus Catulum Syllanum ducem surgens, rediuiuos bellorum ciuilium cineres suscitauit

topic: Brutus pursued by Pompey and killed at Regium
quote_la: Brutus in Cisalpinam Galliam fugiens persequente Pompeio apud Regium interfectus est

topic: Domitius crushed with his army by Sertorius' general Hirtuleius
quote_la: Domitius ab Hirtuleio Sertorii duce cum exercitu oppressus est

topic: Sertorius, fleeing Sulla, rouses the warlike peoples of Spain
quote_la: Syllam fugiens ex Africa dilapsus in Hispanias, bellicosissimas gentes in arma excitauit

topic: Hirtuleius defeated by Metellus at Italica with 20,000 lost
quote_la: Hirtuleius cum Metello congressus apud Italicam Baeticae urbem uiginti milia militum perdidit

topic: drawn battle of Sertorius and Pompey, each victorious on one wing
quote_la: Sertorius deinde cum Pompeio congressus decem milia militum eius interfecit; ex alio cornu uincente Pompeio tantundem paene ipse perdidit

topic: Mithridates concludes a treaty with Sertorius through envoys to Spain
quote_la: Mithridates cum Sertorio per legatos in Hispaniam missos foedus pepigit

topic: Roman commander and army destroyed at Chalcedon by Mithridates' generals
quote_la: magno exercitu breui congregato cum P. Rutilio apud Chalcedonam congressi sunt eumque cum plurima exercitus ipsius parte ceciderunt

topic: Deiotarus of Galatia destroys Mithridates' prefects
quote_la: Deiotarus rex Gallograeciae praefectos regis bello trucidauit

topic: 74 gladiators escape from Capua under Crixus, Oenomaus and Spartacus and seize Vesuvius
quote_la: gladiatores septuaginta et quattuor Capuae a ludo Cn. Lentuli diffugerunt: qui continuo ducibus Crixo et Oenomao Gallis et Spartaco Thrace Vesuuium montem occupauerunt

topic: Mithridates' army besieging Cyzicus wasted by famine and plague
quote_la: apud Cyzicum eadem mora, qua obsidebat, obsessus in magnam penuriam pestilentiamque exercitum suum coartauit

topic: Crixus crushed in battle; consul Lentulus routed by Spartacus
quote_la: Gellius Crixum acerrime pugnantem proelio oppressit, Lentulus a Spartaco superatus aufugit

topic: Sertorius murdered by his own men's treachery
quote_la: ipse Sertorius decimo demum anno belli inchoati isdem quibus et Viriatus suorum dolis interfectus finem bello fecit

topic: Perperna defeated by Pompey and killed with his whole army
quote_la: qui a Pompeio uictus cum uniuerso exercitu suo interfectus est

topic: Crassus defeats the Gallic and German contingents of Spartacus
quote_la: Gallos auxiliatores eius Germanosque superauit, e quibus XXX milia hominum cum ipsis ducibus occidit

topic: Crassus destroys Spartacus and his host: 60,000 killed
quote_la: nam sexaginta milia eorum caesa, sex milia capta referuntur, tria milia ciuium Romanorum recepta sunt

topic: Lucullus defeats Mithridates and Tigranes at Tigranocerta
quote_la: apud Tigranocertam urbem cum Mithridate et Tigrane congressus paruissima suorum manu magnum hostium numerum occidit

topic: Tigranes flees with 150 horsemen, casting away diadem and tiara
quote_la: Tigranes uix centum quinquaginta equitibus comitatus aufugit diademate et tiara ne agnosceretur abiectis

topic: Pompey sweeps the pirates from the whole sea with astonishing speed
quote_la: quos Cn. Pompeius post multam quidem uastationem, quam terra marique diu egerant, mira tamen celeritate conpressit

topic: Metellus subdues Crete in a two-year war
quote_la: Cretam insulam per biennium Metellus euertit diuturnoque bello domitam in potestatem redegit

topic: Metellus replaces the laws of Minos with Roman law in conquered Crete
quote_la: legesque Minois Romanis legibus permutauit

topic: Pompey routs Mithridates in the night battle: 40,000 of the royal army lost
quote_la: namque de exercitu regio XL milia caesa uel capta sunt, Romani uulnerati mille, uix autem quadraginta interfecti

topic: Tigranes pardoned; the Albanian king's forces beaten three times
quote_la: oranti Tigrani ueniam dedit; exercitum Horodis Albanorum regis praefectosque eius ter proelio uicit

topic: Artaces, king of Iberia, defeated and his country surrendered
quote_la: Artacem regem Hiberiae bello fudit totamque Hiberiam in deditionem accepit

topic: Pharnaces wins over the army sent against him and marches on his father
quote_la: exemplo fratrum territus exercitum ad persequendum sese missum sibi conciliauit et mox aduersus patrem duxit

topic: the poison failing, Mithridates has a Gallic soldier cut his throat
quote_la: Gallum quendam militem iam fracto muro discurrentem inuitauit eique iugulum praebuit

topic: Pompey moves against the Jews and Jerusalem
quote_la: hinc ad Iudaeos, quibus Aristobulus expulso fratre Hyrcano primus ex sacerdote rex praeerat, atque ad Hierosolymam urbem eorum Gabinium cum exercitu mittit

topic: Catiline's conspiracy betrayed at Rome and extinguished in Etruria
quote_la: coniuratio Catilinae aduersus patriam per eosdem dies in urbe habita et prodita, in Etruria uero ciuili bello extincta est

topic: Caesar defeats the migrating Helvetii: 47,000 fall
quote_la: ex his quadraginta et septem milia in bello ceciderunt, cetera in terras proprias remissa sunt

topic: Caesar defeats Ariovistus and his German host among the Sequani
quote_la: contra Ariouistum regem excitantem inuehentemque secum incredibiles Germanorum copias, quibus nuper uniuersos Galliarum populos se subegisse iactabat, apud Sequanos uicit

topic: the Belgae, a third of Gaul, rise against Caesar
quote_la: Belgarum gens, quae tertia pars Galliarum est, aduersus Caesarem exarsit

topic: Caesar bridges the Rhine and crosses into Germany
quote_la: Tunc Caesar in Germaniam facto ponte transgreditur, Sugambros et Ubios obsidione liberat

topic: first crossing to Britain marred by hard fighting and storm losses
quote_la: in Britanniam transuehitur. ubi acerba primum pugna fatigatus, deinde aduersa tempestate correptus plurimam classis partem et non paruum numerum militum

topic: second British expedition reaches the Thames against Cassivellaunus
quote_la: inde ad flumen Tamesim profectus, quem uno tantum loco uadis transmeabilem ferunt

topic: Cotta and Sabinus with a whole legion destroyed by Ambiorix's ambush
quote_la: Cottam et Sabinum legatos apud Eburonas cum tota funditus legione insidiis circumuentos interfecit

topic: young Crassus killed in the battle against the Parthians
quote_la: Crassus quoque filius Crassi, lectissimus iuuenis, in acie occisus est

topic: Crassus surrounded and killed by Surenas while seeking a parley
quote_la: Surenas rapto equitatu Crassum persequi intendit eumque circumuentum ac frustra conloquium eius petentem interfecit

topic: Labienus destroys the forces of the Treveri and takes their city
quote_la: Labienus sequenti proelio omnes Treuerorum copias interfecit arte in bellum prouocatas

topic: Caesar pursues Ambiorix and the Eburones into the Ardennes forest
quote_la: Ambiorigem et Eburones deletae legionis auctores postquam in Arduennam siluam refugisse conperit

topic: Vercingetorix, chosen king, summons all Gaul to the war
quote_la: Vercingetorix, quem omnes consensu pari regem praeoptauerant, suadet, uti ex tota Gallia omnes, qui arma ferre possint, huic bello praesto sint

topic: the Gauls at Alesia surrender Vercingetorix to Caesar
quote_la: ilico sibi ueniam precantes, eum solum uelut auctorem magni sceleris dediderunt

topic: the Bellovaci and their allies cut down to annihilation
quote_la: commisso proelio Romani Gallos fugientes isdem locorum munitionibus, quibus clausi fuerant, incluserunt cunctosque ad internecionem ceciderunt

topic: the senate decrees Caesar must dismiss his army before entering the city
quote_la: deinde decretum est a senatu, ut in urbem Caesar non nisi dimisso exercitu ueniret

topic: Caesar wins over Domitius' three legions at Corfinium
quote_la: tres legiones, quae cum Domitio apud Corfinium morabantur, ad suas partes traduxit

topic: Pompey and the senate abandon Italy for Dyrrachium
quote_la: Pompeius atque omnis senatus, crescentibus Caesaris uiribus trepidi, tamquam Italia pulsi in Graeciam transuecti, Dyrrachium gerendi belli sedem delegerunt

topic: Massilia besieged, subdued and stripped of everything but life and liberty
quote_la: Caesar Massiliam rediens, obsidione domitam uita tantum et libertate concessa ceteris rebus abrasit

topic: Petreius and Afranius defeated in Spain and dismissed under terms
quote_la: ibi multis proeliis Petreium Afraniumque superatos conposita pactione dimisit

topic: Curio and his army destroyed in Africa by king Juba
quote_la: Curio ex Sicilia in Africam cum exercitu transgressus est: quem Iuba rex continuo exceptum cum omnibus copiis trucidauit

topic: the praetor Caelius deserts Caesar and joins the exile Milo
quote_la: Caelius desciuit a Caesare ac se Miloni exuli iunxit

topic: Caesar's fifteen-mile siege works fail to shut in Pompey at Dyrrachium
quote_la: Pompeium obsidione frustra cinxit, ipse terram quindecim m. p. fossa praestruens, cum illi maria paterent

topic: Pompey defeated at Pharsalus: 15,000 of his men killed
quote_la: caesa sunt in eo proelio Pompeianorum quindecim milia, centuriones triginta et tres. hic exitus pugnae ad Palaeopharsalum fuit

topic: Pompey murdered on landing in Egypt at young Ptolemy's order
quote_la: iussu Ptolemaei adulescentis in gratiam Caesaris uictoris occisus est

topic: Caesar at Alexandria weeps over Pompey's head and ring
quote_la: Caesar conpositis apud Thessaliam rebus Alexandriam uenit perlatoque ad se ac uiso Pompei capite anuloque fleuit

topic: Alexandrian war: the fire from the royal fleet burns 400,000 books
quote_la: ea flamma cum partem quoque urbis inuasisset, quadringenta milia librorum proximis forte aedibus condita exussit

topic: Pharnaces defeated in Pontus without delay
quote_la: inde Syriam peruagatus Pharnacem in Ponto uicit

topic: Caesar defeats Juba and Scipio at Thapsus with great slaughter
quote_la: in Africam transiit et apud Thapsum cum Iuba et Scipione pugnauit maximamque ibi hominum multitudinem interfecit

topic: Cato kills himself at Utica
quote_la: Cato sese apud Vticam occidit

topic: Juba and Petreius die by their pact
quote_la: Iuba percussori iugulum pretio dato praebuit, Petreius eodem se gladio perfodit

topic: Caesar enters Rome in four triumphs and sets out for Spain
quote_la: inde quattuor triumphis urbem ingressus, disposito recuperatae reipublicae statu continuo in Hispanias contra Pompeios Pompei filios profectus

topic: the last and desperate battle at Munda
quote_la: ultimum bellum apud Mundam flumen gestum est, ubi tantis uiribus dimicatum tantaque caedes acta

topic: Labienus and Attius Varus fall; Cnaeus Pompeius flees
quote_la: T. Labienus et Attius Varus in acie caesi sunt, Gnaeus Pompeius cum centesimo equite aufugit

topic: Caesar stabbed in the curia with twenty-three wounds
quote_la: in curia uiginti et tribus uulneribus confossus interiit

topic: the assassins withdraw with drawn daggers to the Capitol
quote_la: duo Bruti et C. Cassius aliique socii strictis pugionibus in Capitolium secesserunt

topic: Octavian assumes Caesar's inheritance and name and comes to Rome
quote_la: Octauianus, qui testamento Iuli Caesaris auunculi et hereditatem et nomen adsumpserat

topic: Antony, declared an enemy, besieges Decimus Brutus at Mutina
quote_la: Antonius a senatu hostis pronuntiatus D. Brutum apud Mutinam obsidione concluserat

topic: consul Pansa ambushed and mortally wounded
quote_la: Pansa primo ueniens exceptus insidiis, inter suorum clades ipse quoque pilo grauiter uulneratus

topic: consul Hirtius killed in the second battle; Antony routed
quote_la: namque tunc ibi Hirtius consul occisus est, uictus fugit Antonius, Caesar uictoria potitus est

topic: Dolabella kills Trebonius at Smyrna and is declared a public enemy
quote_la: Dolabella Trebonium, unum ex interfectoribus Caesaris, Zmyrnae interfecit. Dolabellam senatus hostem pronuntiauit

topic: the triumvirs post the proscription list of 132 senators
quote_la: centum triginta et duum senatorum nomina in tabula proposita sunt, primum Lepidi praecepto et nomine, deinde Antonii, tertio Caesaris

topic: Antony proscribes Cicero and his own uncle
quote_la: ibi Antonius Tullium Ciceronem inimicum suum, ibi L. Caesarem auunculum suum

topic: Decimus Brutus captured and killed by the Sequani
quote_la: postea D. Brutus in Gallia a Sequanis captus et occisus est

topic: Dolabella, defeated by Cassius in Syria, kills himself
quote_la: Dolabella in Syria multa cum Cassio bella gessit, a quo uictus ipse se interfecit

topic: Brutus and Cassius unite their armies and strip Greece
quote_la: Brutus et Cassius magnis exercitibus conparatis apud Athenas conuenerunt totamque Graeciam depopulati sunt

topic: Cassius forces Rhodes to surrender, leaving the Rhodians only their lives
quote_la: Rhodios Cassius terra marique oppugnatos ad deditionem coegit

topic: Sextus Pompeius turns to piracy, seizes Sicily and starves Rome
quote_la: conuersus in latrocinia omnem oram Italiae caedibus rapinisque uastauit. Sicilia praerepta commeatibusque inpeditis Romam fame adfecit

topic: at Philippi each side's camp is captured in turn
quote_la: mox castra eius ab hostibus capta sunt. sed rursus Caesariani milites Cassi castra ceperunt

topic: Cassius and Brutus die by the hands of their own attendants
quote_la: nam inuitatis percussoribus Cassius caput, Brutus latus praebuit

topic: Fulvia, Antony's wife, wields power at Rome and harasses the returning Caesar
quote_la: at Romae Fuluia, uxor Antoni, socrus Caesaris, dominatum ut mulier agitabat

topic: the Perusine war against Lucius Antonius counted among Octavian's five civil wars
quote_la: bella ciuilia quinque gessit : Mutinense Philippense Perusinum Siculum Actiacum

topic: the triumvirs make peace with Sextus Pompeius
quote_la: mox cum eo pacem triumuiri, ut non dicam tyranni, id est Lepidus Caesar Antoniusque fecerunt

topic: Pompeius breaks the pact by harbouring runaways and is held an enemy
quote_la: sed continuo cum contra pactum Pompeius fugitiuos allegeret, ut hostis habitus est

topic: Caesar's victorious fleet wrecked by storm off Scylaceum
quote_la: sed continuo uictricem classem paene uniuersam apud Scylaceum naufragio amisit

topic: Ventidius routs the invading Parthians thrice and kills king Pacorus
quote_la: Ventidius Persas et Parthos in Syriam inrumpentes tribus bellis maximis fudit regemque eorum Pacorum in acie interfecit

topic: Agrippa defeats the Pompeian fleet between Mylae and the Lipari islands
quote_la: Agrippa inter Mylas et Liparas aduersus Democham et Pompeium nauale proelium gessit ac uicit

topic: final sea victory: 163 ships taken or sunk, Pompeius escapes with seventeen
quote_la: nam centum sexaginta et tres naues aut demersit aut cepit. Pompeius cum decem et septem nauibus uix elapsus euasit

topic: Lepidus humbled, stripped of command, granted life and property
quote_la: deposito paludamento assumptaque ueste pulla, supplex Caesari factus uitam et bona impetrauit

topic: Antony's disastrous retreat from Media to Antioch
quote_la: omnibus undique malis circumuentus, uix tandem Antiochiam cum paucis rediit

topic: famine drives Antony's army to unspeakable food; many desert
quote_la: grauissima fame ad nefandos cibos coactus est; plurimi militum sese hostibus dediderunt

topic: Sextus Pompeius hunted down and killed by Antony's commanders
quote_la: Pompeius fugiens a Titio et Furnio Antonianis ducibus saepe terrestri naualique bello uictus et captus ac post paululum interfectus est

topic: Antony seizes the Armenian king by treachery and binds him in a silver chain
quote_la: Antonius Artabanen Armeniae regem proditione et dolo cepit: quem argentea catena uinctum ad confessionem thesaurorum regiorum coegit

topic: Caesar subdues Illyricum and Pannonia
quote_la: Caesar Illyricum Pannoniam partemque Italiae bellis subegit ac domuit

topic: Antony repudiates Octavia and summons Cleopatra to meet him
quote_la: Octauiae, sorori Caesaris, uxori suae, repudium indici iussit et Cleopatram sibi ex Alexandria occurrere imperauit

topic: at Actium Cleopatra flees first with sixty ships and Antony follows her
quote_la: prior regina Cleopatra cum LX uelocissimis nauibus fugit; Antonius quoque detracto insigni praetoriae nauis fugientem secutus uxorem est

topic: Antony stabs himself and is carried half-dead to Cleopatra's monument
quote_la: idem Antonius sese ferro transuerberauit ac semianimis ad Cleopatram in monumentum, in quod se illa mori certa condiderat, perlatus est

topic: Cleopatra, to escape the triumph, dies of the serpent's bite
quote_la: serpentis, ut putatur, morsu in sinistro tacta bracchio exanimis inuenta est

topic: Caesar enters Rome in triple triumph, closes Janus, and is first hailed Augustus
quote_la: hoc die primum Augustus consalutatus est

topic: Augustus opens Janus and leads the army against the Cantabri and Astures
quote_la: si Cantabros atque Astures, duas fortissimas Hispaniae gentes, suis uti legibus sineret, aperuit Iani portas atque in Hispanias ipse cum exercitu profectus est

topic: Drusus allotted Gaul and Raetia and subdues great German peoples
quote_la: Claudius Drusus, priuignus Caesaris, Galliam Raetiamque sortitus maximas fortissimasque gentes Germaniae armis subegit

topic: Drusus subdues the Usipetes, Tencteri and Chatti in Germany
quote_la: Drusus in Germania primum Usipetes, deinde Tencteros et Chattos perdomuit

topic: Drusus subdues the Cherusci, Suebi and Sygambri in one war
quote_la: Cheruscos Suebos et Sygambros pariter uno bello

topic: Tiberius crushes the newly rebellious Pannonians
quote_la: Pannonios nouo motu intumescentes Tiberius priuignus Caesaris cruentissima caede deleuit

topic: the Parthians voluntarily return the standards taken from Crassus
quote_la: ultro signa, quae Crasso interfecto abstulerant, ad Caesarem remiserunt

topic: Drusus' final trans-Rhine campaigns (his death is not narrated by Orosius)
quote_la: Marcomannos paene ad internecionem cecidit
